title: Oil cooler fouled — Oil temperature high
cause: Dust and oil film on the cooler matrix keep the cooling air from carrying the heat away, so the oil leaves the cooler warmer than it should on every cycle.
checks: Look through the cooler matrix against the light and check how much of it is blocked.
Compare the oil temperature of a cool night with the same duty on a warm afternoon.
Confirm that the cooling fan runs whenever the oil is above its switching temperature.
remedy: Clean the cooler matrix from the fan side with low-pressure air, straighten bent fins and repeat the cleaning at the interval of the maintenance plan rather than only when the temperature rises.

evidence.observation: Oil temperature ran above its normal band for two hours and rose steadily through the shift.
